product_description: A hybrid online learning app combining Udemy-style structured courses with Duolingo-style daily streak gamification to conquer student course dropouts.
target_audience: College students and working professionals aged 20-35 who enroll in online courses but fail to finish them.
research_objectives: Discover why learners drop out of courses after the first week
Test reaction to bite-sized 5-minute daily lessons vs 45-minute lectures
Evaluate willingness to pay for subscriptions vs one-time course fees
Identify if streaks and XP leaderboards create genuine motivation
